design_decisions.title: module_local_responsive_repairs
design_decisions.rationale: The reported R9 defects are in module-owned layouts and must not be hidden by changing the application shell.
constraints: Use LayoutBuilder, Wrap, Flexible, or bounded scrolling only inside microtask, isolate-basic, and adsorption-line ownership boundaries.
Preserve 600dp and 1280dp behavior and existing semantics.
Do not modify LearningScaffold, NavigationPolicy, global routing, packages, pubspec, or platform directories.
Add or extend tests in the existing canonical module test paths.
acceptance: 360x860, 600x860, and 1280x860 targeted widget tests have no RenderFlex exception.
Critical controls remain findable and reachable at 360x860.

design_decisions.title: multiwindow_diagnostics_without_windows_claims
design_decisions.rationale: The Issue #18 Windows multiwindow test files are absent from this checkout, so local work must improve observability without fabricating Windows results.
constraints: Preserve MultiWindowManager, app_bootstrap, and CategoryWindowApp contracts.
Any diagnostics must use safe structured fields: category, arguments type, controller/window id, operation, elapsed time, and error/stack trace.
Do not infer HWND, PID, title, or Windows first-frame behavior from macOS or widget tests.
Do not create or modify a Windows acceptance report to claim PASS.
acceptance: Any new diagnostic behavior has deterministic unit coverage.
Windows runtime status remains BLOCKED or UNKNOWN until a Windows host or authoritative Windows CI run executes it.

design_decisions.title: bounded_test_execution
design_decisions.rationale: The reported monolithic Windows test timeout obscures the last completed case and risks residual processes.
constraints: Only modify an integration test when the exact file exists or create a clearly named maintained test with a complete entrypoint.
Use bounded waits and explicit timeout diagnostics; do not add unbounded pumpAndSettle.
Close child windows and cancel timers/subscriptions in teardown.
Never terminate processes by executable name; use only PIDs created and recorded by the test harness.
A timeout is FAIL or BLOCKED evidence, never PASS.
acceptance: Every changed or new test has an exact runnable command.
Timeout output identifies the last completed case.
No existing test is deleted or weakened.

design_decisions.title: windows_build_diagnosis
design_decisions.rationale: An existing executable does not prove that flutter build windows --release completed successfully.
constraints: Run only on Windows or authoritative Windows CI.
Capture build start time, exit code, active stage, process tree, artifact mtime, and required DLL inventory.
Do not accept a stale pre-existing Release artifact.
Keep release workflow and packaging changes out of scope.
acceptance: Build exits 0 with fresh artifact provenance, or a precise external/toolchain blocker is recorded.
A clean launch smoke verifies the fresh executable.

design_decisions.title: local_commit_no_push
design_decisions.rationale: Local commits are allowed for the reviewed fix, but remote operations remain prohibited.
constraints: Run targeted tests, flutter analyze, git diff --check, and bash tool/quality_gate.sh before committing.
Do not git push, tag, release, merge, rebase, force-push, amend prior commits, or update GitHub Issue #18.
Do not close Issue #18 until authoritative Windows evidence satisfies the final gate.
acceptance: New commits are attributable to this task.
No unreviewed source or platform files are included.
